tuning_guide.platform: HPE ProLiant Gen11 / Synergy 480 Gen11 (Intel Xeon 4th/5th Gen Sapphire/Emerald Rapids)

hpe_baseline_drift.oem_guide_title: UEFI System Utilities and ESXi Performance Tuning for HPE ProLiant Gen11 Servers

drifts.rationale: Workload Profile is set to factory default or energy-saving profile (GeneralPowerEfficientCompute). Dynamic frequency throttling and power-capping introduce CPU and memory latency spikes during vSAN ESA burst I/O. Recommended: Set Workload Profile to Virtualization-MaxPerformance.
drifts.citation: HPE Deploying and updating VMware ESXi on HPE servers (a00061651enw)

drifts.rationale: Power Regulator is set to Dynamic Power Savings Mode (DynamicPowerSavings). BIOS autonomously scales CPU frequency. May introduce minor latency jitter during vSAN ESA storage bursts. VMware recommends Static High-Performance or OS Control Mode.
drifts.citation: Broadcom KB 1018206 — Host Power Management & BIOS Performance Profiles

drifts.rationale: Energy-Efficient Turbo is Enabled (Enabled). Part of the Virtualization-Power Efficient profile. For maximum consistent CPU throughput, VMware KB 1018206 and HPE Virtualization-MaxPerformance recommend Disabled.
drifts.citation: Broadcom KB 1018206 — Host Power Management & BIOS Performance Profiles

rules.rationale: Workload Profile is set to factory default or energy-saving profile (GeneralPowerEfficientCompute). Dynamic frequency throttling and power-capping introduce CPU and memory latency spikes during vSAN ESA burst I/O. Recommended: Set Workload Profile to Virtualization-MaxPerformance.
rules.citation: HPE Deploying and updating VMware ESXi on HPE servers (a00061651enw)

rules.rationale: Power Regulator is set to Dynamic Power Savings Mode (DynamicPowerSavings). BIOS autonomously scales CPU frequency. May introduce minor latency jitter during vSAN ESA storage bursts. VMware recommends Static High-Performance or OS Control Mode.
rules.citation: Broadcom KB 1018206 — Host Power Management & BIOS Performance Profiles

rules.rationale: Processor Core C-States is set to C6. Normal for OS Control Mode / ESXi Balanced Power Policy. For latency-sensitive or strict low-jitter workloads, KB 1018206 recommends setting to No C-states.
rules.citation: VMware vSphere 9.1 Performance Best Practices, C-States (p. 22)

rules.rationale: Energy-Efficient Turbo is Enabled (Enabled). Part of the Virtualization-Power Efficient profile. For maximum consistent CPU throughput, VMware KB 1018206 and HPE Virtualization-MaxPerformance recommend Disabled.
rules.citation: Broadcom KB 1018206 — Host Power Management & BIOS Performance Profiles

rules.rationale: Hardware-assisted CPU virtualization is Enabled. Required for ESXi 64-bit guest virtual machine execution.
rules.citation: VMware vSphere 9.1 Performance Best Practices, Hardware-Assisted CPU Virtualization (VT-x and AMD-V™) (p. 12)

rules.rationale: Directed I/O virtualization (VT-d / AMD IOMMU) is Enabled (or Auto). Required for PCI pass-through, vSAN Direct, and DPU/SmartNIC operations.
rules.citation: VMware vSphere 9.1 Performance Best Practices, Hardware-Assisted I/O MMU Virtualization (VT-d and AMD-Vi) (p. 12)

rules.rationale: Logical Processor (Hyper-Threading / SMT) is Enabled. Exposes maximum logical execution contexts to ESXi CPU scheduler.
rules.citation: VMware vSphere 9.1 Performance Best Practices, Hyper-Threading Considerations (p. 19)

rules.setting_name: Processor Turbo Boost / Core Performance Boost
rules.rationale: Processor Turbo Boost is Enabled. Allows opportunistic execution frequency scaling above nominal TDP baseline.
rules.citation: VMware vSphere 9.1 Performance Best Practices, Turbo Boost (p. 23)

rules.rationale: SR-IOV is Enabled (forced by Virtualization-MaxPerformance). Allows PCIe NICs to expose hardware Virtual Functions (VFs).
rules.citation: HPE UEFI Workload-based Performance and Tuning Guide (881335-002)

rules.rationale: NUMA Group Size Optimization is set to Flat. Keeps NUMA topology fully visible to the ESXi CPU scheduler.
rules.citation: HPE UEFI Workload-based Performance and Tuning Guide (881335-002)

rules.rationale: Sub-NUMA Clustering is Disabled. Avoids partitioning physical sockets into multiple smaller NUMA domains, preserving standard 1-node-per-socket memory locality for vSAN ESA and general VMs.
rules.citation: HPE Solutions for SAP HANA and VMware vSAN on DL380 Gen11 (a50016126enw)

rules.rationale: System Boot Mode is configured for UEFI. Mandatory for VCF 9.1, modern NVMe pass-through, and TPM 2.0 measurement.
rules.citation: VMware vSphere 9.1 Performance Best Practices, System BIOS and Platform Firmware (p. 17)
